scope: Implement and verify the generated-graph rooted ACIS/SAB body projection slice S3.7c for the reviewed ACIS BinaryFile 21800 profile.

apiChanges: Added categorized rooted-projection failure reasons: unsupported profile, invalid model/reference, owner mismatch, resource limit, allocation failure, and unexpected failure.
Reports the failed source node and pointer ordinal when localized; output projections are cleared on failure.
Reports cycle components for list-next, coedge-next, and coedge-partner functional links.
Reports nodes reachable from more than one body root.
testCoverage: Two independently rooted bodies retain distinct source identities and raw, unscaled coordinates.
Transform presence is reported while transform application, unit scaling, and B-rep validation remain false.
Multiple lumps, shells, and ordered face loops are traversed.
Coedge next cycles and non-manifold partner rings are preserved and counted.
Unsupported pattern, wire, subshell, p-curve, curve, and surface branches receive family counts.
A valid edge endpoint whose vertex.edge points to another edge is accepted.
Outside-root vertex/edge/face counts, empty body roots, and multiply-rooted nodes are tested.
Wrong-type and inconsistent references, owner mismatch, unsupported 20800/22300/signature profiles, and resource limits fail with cleared output.
implementation.evidenceBoundary: This proves bounded structural traversal and report behavior on locally generated graphs only. It does not prove ACIS normative schema coverage, transform or unit meaning, B-rep validity/closure, DWG AcDs linkage, or native CAD/independent semantic support.

followUp.nextLocalSlice: Keep raw transform literals/hints intact, expose explicit parse state, and add generated asymmetric transform vectors before applying placement. Keep source-unit conversion separate.
followUp.commitNote: The worktree already contains overlapping uncommitted ACIS and plan changes; no partial staging or broad commit was made.
